parameters.query: SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1

SELECT id, option_number, title, description, intervention_logic, rooms_layout, technical_notes, conflict_points, pros, cons, is_selected FROM design_options WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND exec_status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY CASE WHEN is_selected = true THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, version, summary, client_needs, objectives, constraints, style_preferences, rooms_affected FROM briefings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND exec_status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM agent_prompts WHERE agent_name = 'agent_materials' AND is_active = true ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_materials', 'running') RETURNING id

INSERT INTO material_items (project_id, category, name, unit_price, unit, quantity_estimated, total_estimated, quality_tier, room_area, source_url, notes, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, CASE $2 WHEN 'revestimientos' THEN 'revestimiento' WHEN 'fontaneria' THEN 'sanitarios' WHEN 'electricidad' THEN 'otro' WHEN 'estructura' THEN 'otro' WHEN 'acabados' THEN 'otro' WHEN 'instalaciones' THEN 'otro' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF($2,''),'otro') END, $3, $4::numeric, CASE WHEN $5 IN ('m2','ml','ud','m3','kg','l') THEN $5 ELSE 'ud' END, $6::numeric, CASE WHEN $4::numeric IS NOT NULL AND $6::numeric IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(($4::numeric * $6::numeric)::numeric,2) ELSE NULL END, 'media', $7, $8, $9, 'suggested') RETURNING id
UPDATE material_items SET status = 'approved' WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'suggested'
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid

parameters.query: SELECT id, supplier_name, category, item_name, brand, model_ref, unit_price, unit, quality_tier, notes FROM supplier_catalog WHERE valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY category, CASE quality_tier WHEN 'economica' THEN 1 WHEN 'media' THEN 2 WHEN 'alta' THEN 3 WHEN 'premium' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
